results.title: Was Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan an Indian musician?
results.snippet: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan was a renowned Pakistani musician known for his powerful contributions to the genre of qawwālī, a form of Sufi devotional music. Born into a family with a long history of qawwālī performance, Khan initially faced opposition to pursuing music, as his family hoped he would become a doctor.
